market_read.tone: Risk-off: global AI/chip rout (Asia -5%), Nasdaq futures down ~1.5-1.9%, VIX >30, gold and bitcoin falling too, after SPY -2.94% / QQQ -3.87% on Nov 19 and six straight S&P losses.
market_read.day_type: event-driven (gap down; trend down is the base case, a violent oversold bounce is the main alternative)
market_read.comment: Coach asked for the bias to match the calls; it does, at modest confidence. SPY prior close 716.27 (day low 715.65), a -0.8% gap opens near 710. Unlike Nov 17-19 this is a gap DOWN into no nearby support from our bars, so the gap-and-fade pattern of the last week argues for an early bounce, not for more selling at the bell. If SPY gets back above 716 by 10:30, drop the down bias. Monthly opex and VIX 30 mean wide ranges either way.
